reason: All carry the two-fruit and seven-fruit formulas in full; T1 renders paṭihacca (early) and uddhaṃsoto akaniṭṭhagāmī = reference; T2=T4 render akaniṭṭhagāmī as "to the Pure Abodes" (reference: Akaniṭṭha realm); T3 drops paṭihacca ("early on")

All three carry both ten-member lists (paripanthā / āhārā) in source order with the framing refrains, matching the reference (wealth, beauty, health, ethics, spiritual life, friends, learning, wisdom, good qualities, heaven); T2 alone also renders footnotes 1-4 accurately; no member dropped or reversed in any
All carry the five hindrances, five kāmaguṇā, the impossibility formula and the fire simile incl. aññatra iddhimatā as in the reference; T3 renders nivuṭo (hindered) as "secluded", a minor term slip

T1 and T3 drop 'samaggatā sammāpaṭipannā' (reference: 'rightly comported and rightly practiced') from the wrong-view formula; T2 keeps it but adds 'by his own actions' to yathābhataṃ (twice) and 'no special debt to' mother/father, absent from source; all carry the four heaven-side precepts with the know/see pairs correctly oriented

v837 'ajjhattasantiṃ pacinaṃ adassaṃ' = reference 'searching, I saw inner peace': T3 renders it (first person); T2 shifts to 'he seeks... having seen through it' and in v839 drops anissāya ('independent'); T1 misparses it as 'having seen nothingness' and also shifts the speaker to 'he'

v19 'acchijja nessati maccurājassa pāraṃ' = reference 'lead them past the King of Death': T2 renders it; T1 makes anoko describe the multitude and turns pāraṃ into 'severed the snares'; T3 reverses it to 'carry away the multitude to the King of Death' and splits gaṇa-saṅgha-cārī into 'the crowd, and the current'; Māra's verses and the uddāna are complete in all

All three render the rag, outcaste-child and dehorned-bull similes with the full refrain; T2 garbles 'daharo vā yuvā vā' into 'a woman or a man, or a youth' (drops the young/youthful pair); T1 ('cut off', 'young') and T3 ('broken horns', 'young or in the prime of life') differ only by minor term choices, T1's bracketed [horrified] is flagged as inference

T2 renders 'na hoti paccattaṃ sahadhammiko samaṇavādo' as no rightful claim to being ascetics (= reference 'can't rightly be called ascetics') and keeps every step; T1 keeps the ten-fold 'pubbe katahetu' refrain but turns samaṇavāda into 'a doctrine of righteous living'; T3 recasts the reductio 'you will be killers... because of past deeds' as an if-clause premise feeding the next sentence and also reads samaṇavāda as 'a rightful doctrine'

All four keep the four cloud types, the nine-fold aṅga list (sutta...vedalla) and the four-truths pe-elisions in the correct thunder/rain pairings as in the reference; T2 and T3 are identical text; no candidate swaps a pariyāpuṇāti/pajānāti negation

All three render the rūpa/arūpa and sakkāya/sakkāyanirodha escapes, the five-fold nandi...nānuseti list and the niranusayo/acchejji taṇhaṃ/sammā-mānābhisamayā close as the reference does; T1 and T3 also translate the 12 variant-reading footnotes, which T2 drops entirely (and T2 adds 'painful' to 'na so taṃ vedanaṃ vediyati')

All three keep the adhamma/dhamma, anattha/attha summary each time it recurs, the monks' deliberation, the praise of Mahākaccāna and the approach, matching the reference; differences are only word choice (profitable/beneficial, dwelling/monastery) and how the apparatus line is rendered

All three render vv.250-255 and the story references as the reference does; T3 also keeps the variant-reading footnotes and the Jāt III 223 cross-reference; T2 condenses that apparatus into a one-line summary note; T1 drops the apparatus and labels the 'etaṃ' of v.250 as 'asava', which the source does not say (in the reference it is the upset over others' food from v.249)

T1 renders patissave as offense for the promise/agreeing (ref: for agreeing) and sattaham anagataya pavaranaya as seven days before the invitation; T2 misreads patissava as the leaving throughout and garbles para 7 as before the seven days are up; T3 misreads patissava as the arrival, drops sattaham in para 7 (before the pavarana has arrived) and renders patipadena as at dawn

T1 and T2 both carry the full opening, the four satipatthana formulas and the eight anapana steps matching source and ref (T1 noble path for nayassa adhigamaya is the commentarial gloss, T2 true method; neither changes meaning); T3 returned no translation (refusal)

Source opens with the third-jhana close (nippitikena sukhena; ref: bliss free of rapture): T2 renders it correctly, T1 and T3 turn it into pleasure born of seclusion (first-jhana formula) and reduce upekkhasatiparisuddhi to purified by equanimity; T1 also drops jatima from the gem list in both occurrences, T3 keeps it (natural)

All four turn the conclusion of 17 and 18 (sikkha ca apaccakkhata; ref: without the training being renounced) into the training cast aside/renounced, erasing the contrast with 19; T1/T2 (identical) and T4 read samanna cavitukamo as a novice (samaneru), T3 keeps a monk wanting to leave and says/declares as in ref; T4 further adds a monk or a novice in 19 and misparses dubbalyavikammanceva as a compound -kkhepa
